Title: SPECTOR/SPECTOR-E Clear Full Visor
Body (HTML):
ABUS Clear Full Visor for the SPECTOR and SPECTOR-E safety helmets. Protects the eyes and face over a large area from liquids, chips and other objects as well as from weather influences such as rain and wind.

Wearing our full visor prevents injuries and accidents at work. A large polycarbonate lens protects your eyes and face as well as possible from dangerous foreign objects. Equipped with a reinforced frame to make it particularly impact-resistant. A full visor is recommended as part of the personal protective equipment especially for heavy construction and assembly work and in forestry.

At the same time, the anti-fog panoramic window offers an optimum field of vision for the work to be carried out. Visibility always remains clear, even in difficult conditions and extreme temperatures.

The full visor can be easily attached to or removed from the ABUS safety helmet using adapters (included in the scope of delivery). It is height-adjustable and therefore offers excellent freedom of movement.

Offering two-wheelers a high level of security against theft
How it works:
Lock two-wheeler to a fixed object (e.g. lamppost, road sign, fence)

Hardened overlapping steel jacket envelops a strong steel cable - double security

Strong PVC sheathing provides prevents damage to the bicycle paintwork

Quality automatic locking ABUS cylinder lock with hardened steel protection to protect against drilling and pulling attacks.

Title: 96CSTI/50mm TITALIUM™ Padlock Keyed Alike KA7566
Body (HTML):

Hardened steel shackle with NANO PROTECT™ shackle coating which assures security and high corrosion resistance. The simple reversible key is 10 pin and offers 150,000 key variations. The padlock also features automatic locking and features an impressive stainless steel like finish.

TITALIUM™ is based on a special aluminium alloy. A mixture of materials is created that is extremely durable and lightweight; similar to the process used in aircraft construction.

Title: MS002 Fuel Enhancer 100ml
Body (HTML):
The ALM Manufacturing MS002 Fuel Enhancer is designed to be used as an additive for petrol and diesel, 2-stroke, and 4-stroke engines to preserve fuel when the engine is not used for long periods or when the fuel must remain in the tank for a long period, for example over winter in a lawnmower.
It helps stabilise and prolong the useful life of fuel by protecting it against oxidation and helps ease starting after long periods of no use. It also helps protect engine parts against corrosion.
It's recommended uses include:
In fuel before starting up after a long period of no use.
In fuel before starting a long period of no use.
All types of petrol and diesel 2 stroke and 4 stroke engines.
Marine engines (in-board or outboard).
All garden machinery engines including lawnmowers, grass trimmers, hedge trimmers, leaf blowers, etc.
When a tank of fuel lasts more than a month.

Just mix MS002 Fuel Enhancer into the fuel, 100ml treats 5 litres of fuel.

Title: GUARD Smart Van Alarm & Tracker
Body (HTML):
The Roamguard GUARD Smart Van Alarm & Tracker has been designed to protect your livelihood, this cutting-edge device offers a host of features which will make it an invaluable asset to any tradesperson, providing not only peace of mind but also enhancing the chances of recovering stolen tools.

The 'Plug and Play' alarm can be set up within two minutes, with no technical knowledge required. You simply plug it into the OBD port in your van. The alarm is powered by your vehicle’s OBD port, ensuring it remains operational without draining your van’s battery. You can rely on ARMD Guard to protect your tools without compromising your vehicle’s performance. 

One of Roamguard's standout features is its silent alert system. In the unfortunate event of a break-in, Roamguard discreetly calls you while the criminals are in action, without them knowing. This allows you to take swift action, potentially leading to the capture of the culprits and the recovery of your stolen tools. 

Auto-Scheduling allows users to schedule when the Guard is on or off, saving time and hassle. No remembering to turn it on at night or off in the morning if you leave for work at a fixed time.    

The built-in GPS technology allows you to track your van’s location and movements in real-time. Whether you need to keep tabs on your vehicle or recover it in case of theft, it has you covered. You can arm and disarm with ease via the App, ensuring your van is always protected when you need it to be.   

The sensor boasts an impressive seven year battery life, offering extended protection without the hassle of frequent battery replacements.

Specifications:

Connectivity: Bluetooth 4.0.
Detection Range: up to 5m.
Hub Dimensions: 52.6 x 29.1 x 26mm.
Motion Sensor Dimensions: Ø57mm.

Title: B401 Medium Viscosity Cyanoacrylate 20g
Body (HTML):
Bondloc B401 is a Medium Viscosity Cyanoacrylate. It bonds metals, plastics, wood, ceramics, rubber, leather, card, glass and many other materials.

Cyanoacrylate adhesives cure through reaction with moisture held on the surface to be bonded. They need close fitting joints and usually solidify in seconds which has resulted in the universal generic name of 'superglues'. Curing is started by the film of moisture found on most surfaces which is usually slightly alkaline and it is this alkalinity which causes the polymerisation.

Most grades have varying viscosities and therefore they need close fitting joints. Newer developments of gelled variants allow cure in wider gaps and application to vertical surfaces. Cyanoacrylates are suited to small plastic parts and to rubber bonding.

Title: Jump Leads - 2.5m / 200 amp
Body (HTML):
To start a car with a flat battery you need the S Style SSJL200, a set of good quality heavy-duty cables with beefy clamps at each end, and a friend is also a good help! Your friend must have a car with a battery in good condition, as this will aid in the success on starting your flat battery.

Simply position another car near yours so that the batteries are close, but do not let the vehicles touch. Connect one end of the red jump lead to the positive (+) terminal of the boosting battery (Do not let the other end of the red lead touch any vehicle metal components) and connect the other end of the red lead to the positive (+) terminal of the flat battery.

Then connect one end of the black jump lead to the negative (-) terminal of the boosting battery and connect the other end of the black lead to a bolt or metal bracket, well away from the battery, on the engine block of the vehicle to be started is a good source.

Ensure that the jump leads cannot come into contact with any moving parts of either engine. Start the engine of the boosting vehicle and run it at a fast idle speed for a few minuets. Now turn the ignition to start the engine of your vehicle, the leads will pull power from the boosting battery to help your battery back to life. Check that your vehicle is running properly then carefully disconnect the leads, and your on your way.

200 Amp.
2.5m length.
Jump lead with 10mm insulation.
Supplied in poly bag with euro slot.

Title: D25303DH Cordless Dust Extraction System 18V Bare Unit

Title: DCE590N Grabo Suction Lifter 18V Bare Unit
Body (HTML):
The DEWALT DZE590 Suction Lifter is ideal for use in various trades and applications. Providing precision and care on the job. Simple operation; Pump On/Off button and Release button (long press). It features an easy to use digital display. The Material-App guide button allows you to adjust the load limit to the recommended range. There is also an Indication Bar for suction action [low to max. (auto off)].

Green indicates when the pump has stopped its operation and remained 'ON' (can auto recover the suction level) The bar turns green only when the tool reaches to -0.6 BAR. If the release button is pressed by mistake while the bar is green - the pump will go back on to prevent unintended release.

Red indicates when PSI level is lower then -0.6 bar when the pump is working. If the pump is unable to go over -0.6 BAR, it will stay red. In case of pressure drop and the pump is manually turned off– the red bar blinks. The user sees the bar turn red before pressing the release button.

Works on semi-porous and textured surfaces; concrete, stone, metal, wood, marble, drywall, plexiglass, textured plates, patterned glass, cement boards, large tiles, particle boards and MDF. It even works on wet surfaces.

Comes as a bare unit, NO battery or charger supplied.

Specifications:

Lift Capacity: 120kg.

Body (HTML):

Particularly suitable for aluminium and other abrasive materials. Ideal for drilling wood and chipboard.

Suitable for both hand and machine use.

Title: SILENZZO 18/160 PROFESSIONAL Air Compressor 18V Bare Unit
Body (HTML):
The Einhell SILENZZO 18/160 PROFESSIONAL Air Compressor is an ideal helper for compressed air work around the house, workshop and garage. This powerful cordless compressor is equipped with a 6-litre tank and generates up to 8 bar of working pressure. It works with an intake capacity of maximum 160 litres per minute and a discharge capacity of up to 95 l/minute. Its oil-free and service-free pump requires little service effort or maintenance. 

Despite its high performance, the mobile cordless compressor SILENZZO works particularly quietly and produces hardly any noise due to its rubberised and low-vibration positioned feet. A pressure gauge is available for the regulated working pressure as well as for the boiler pressure. The compressor is also equipped with a quick coupler, which therefore enables quick and easy connection of compressed air or pneumatic tools. 

The desired working pressure can be set manually by means of the pressure regulator. For convenient maintenance, the cordless compressor is equipped with a drainage tap, via which the condensed water can be easily drained. The practical carrying handle, its sturdy tubular frame and its low weight mean the compressor is mobile and can be easily transported to the desired place of use. For storing separately available accessories, a storage compartment is integrated into the battery housing. 

Part of the Power X-Change family. Powered by Lithium-ion rechargeable batteries with a battery management system for a long life.

Supplied as a Bare Unit - No Battery or Charger supplied.

Max. Operating Pressure: 8 bar
Motor Speed: 1,750/min.

Title: Ready Mixed Wallcovering Adhesive 4.5kg
Body (HTML):
This Everbuild Ready Mixed Wallcovering Adhesive is a paste suitable for hanging all wall coverings including sculptured, blown, and textured vinyl, washable and heavily embossed wallpapers.
The product has a high, initial, tack combined with excellent adjustability for accurate positioning.
Easily applied, the smooth formula works on most types of wallpapers, containing a powerful fungicide to prevent mould growth whilst the paste is drying.
Ensure surfaces are clean, dry, and free from any loose or flaky material, while gloss or non-porous surfaces should be rubbed down to improve adhesion. Porous surfaces should be sized with a 1-1 dilution of this paste with water, before hanging.
Then, use neat when hanging, and apply with a brush, roller, or fine-notched trowel, wipe off excess with a damp cloth before this product dries.
Clean tools immediately after use, with warm water. Will hang up to 5 rolls.

Title: 408 Super Seal (Exterior Wall Seal) 5 Litre
Body (HTML):
Everbuild 408 Super Seal (formerly Exterior Wall Seal) is a high-performance, solvent based, transparent water-repellent, specially formulated to provide a water-repellent finish and prevent attack by water penetration on porous substrates such as brick, stone, concrete, plaster, plasterboard, pebbledash, rendering, porous tiling, grouting etc.

Title: Wallpaper Stripper 500ml
Body (HTML):
This Everbuild Wallpaper Stripper is a highly concentrated solution of surfactants designed to help strip wallpaper quickly and easily. The 500ml makes up to 4 gallons (18 litres) of solution, and will work on most types of wallpapers.

Pour approx. 1/4 of a bottle into 1 gallon (4.5 litres) of hot water, then stir well and work into the wallpaper with a sponge, scoring the wallpaper beforehand will help penetration. Remember, this is essential with washable wallpaper.
Leave the Stripper on for 5-15 minutes, to take effect, and then remove paper with a scraper or steamer. If there are several layers of paper process may need to be repeated.

Naturally, protect carpets, furniture, and then mop up any spills of liquid, immediately.

Built around a 130W induction motor, the Hulk Electric wacker plate delivers 5kN of compaction force using low-frequency, high-amplitude vibration. Title: Sheet Metal Butt Welding Clamps 4 Piece
Body (HTML):
These Faithfull Butt Welding Clamps are an essential accessory for aligning sheet metal panels edge-to-edge and surface-to-surface. They provide the correct gap to help produce clean welds, requiring minimal grinding after completion.
The 4-piece butt welding clamps are simple to use for assembling and fabricating, and are ideal for welding patch repairs in floors, wings, door skins, or fabricating panels on reskinning projects. These versatile clamps will hold flat, curved and pressed ribbed panels.

Using the Faithfull clamps to assemble the workpiece:

Slacken the wing nut allowing space for the metal sheets to locate between the base of the clamp with the toggle bar underneath. Tighten the wing nut to pull the toggle bar up, locking the two sheets together, side by side.
Once the two sections have been tack welded together, the wing nut can be slackened, and the toggle bar removed. The clamp can then be lifted from the job prior to final welding.

Title: pH Meter 200mm Long Probe
Body (HTML):
This Faithfull pH Meter is easy to use and an essential instrument for both the professional and keen gardening enthusiast, providing a quick, no fuss method of measuring the pH (acidity and alkalinity) value of soil.
Knowing the pH value is very important and directly influences the health of plants, using this meter to provide an accurate reading will allow the pH level to be adjusted accordingly to best suit the plants being grown prior to planting.
The meter can also be used to help identify the best growing environment, and area for growing outdoor plants, shrubs, vegetables, trees, and for improving, modifying soil in your garden.

Features:
Analogue needle Acid-Alkaline indicator.
Accurate pH soil reading in 60 seconds.
Ideal for fruit and vegetables.
No batteries required.

To change soil pH:

A. To increase the pH value, lime should be added. Lime is a compound of calcium, or calcium and magnesium. Applied in the form of ground agricultural limestone, burnt lime or hydrated lime for the quickest result.

B. To decrease the pH value use either aluminium sulphate or sulphur. Aluminium sulphate is the quickest acting as it will increase the acidity as soon as it dissolves into the soil.

Quantities of additives will vary depending on the type of soil, consult a gardening book or professional gardener if further advice is needed.

The Faithfull Essentials Hand Fork has sharp pointed tines which are ideal for working the top soil and for the easy removal of weeds and unwanted growth, where the entire root needs to be removed.

The head is manufactured from heat-treated (hardened) carbon steel to provide both strength and durability. The powder-coated finish provides improved resistance to rust, scratches, humidity and alkaloids in the soil.

Fitted with a comfortable plastic handle.

As they are often used for digging up weeds, hand forks are sometimes referred to as 'weeding forks' but they are suited to many jobs around the garden, such as preparing planting holes, transplanting, aerating and mixing additives into your soil and are indispensable for levelling around border edges and tidying up the soil. The small hand fork makes a good all-round garden tool, especially in those tight places like between plantings.

Title: Flooring Clamp
Body (HTML):
This unique clamp is specially designed for closing gaps between floorboards before securing them in position.

Extremely robust and compact, the clamps are standard equipment for professional flooring contractors, and they are designed to provide a long and reliable service life. The smooth operating bevel gears are fully enclosed in a solid grey iron casing for protection against dust and dirt.

Features include strong spring loaded malleable iron cams, a high quality steel main screw and drop handle, and easy portability.

Used in pairs, these clamps are easy to operate. When they are pushed down onto the joist, the spring loaded cams adjust automatically to create a positive grip on any joist between 38mm and 89mm (11/2 to 31/2) inches wide. The handle is then rotated to wind the shoe out against the floorboard until it is pushed fully home against the adjoining board and nailed before releasing the clamp.

Title: FlexiFit Trowel Plastic Blade with Foam Kit 16in (406mm)

The FlexiFit Trowel from Faithfull Tools, now with the innovative 1mm thick plastic blades, combines cutting-edge design with practical functionality to deliver superior plastering performance. These blades are perfect for professionals seeking flexibility and a flawless matt finish without the need for additional water application.

Blade Features :-

Material: The FlexiFit plastic blades are 1mm thick, providing a robust yet flexible option for plastering.

Foam Backing: Each blade is fitted with a unique patented 10mm water-resistant foam backing, enhancing flexibility and ensuring consistent pressure application on both walls and ceilings.

Finish Quality: These blades produce a professional matt finish, eliminating the need for water on the final coat and achieving superb results when used dry.

Plaster Pliability: Unlike metal blades, the plastic variant does not draw water to the surface, keeping the plaster pliable for longer, allowing for more precise and controlled work.

Dual-Edge Design: The blades feature one edge with square corners and the other with rounded corners to accommodate individual plasterer preferences and increase application versatility.

Repairable: Small damages to the plastic blades can be easily repaired by rubbing down the damaged area with wet and dry paper, extending the blade's life.

Handle Design: The ergonomically shaped ‘camel back’ handle provides additional knuckle clearance and features a soft grip for maximum comfort during prolonged use, reducing strain on arms and joints and helping to prevent Repetitive Strain Injuries (RSI).

Easy Blade Integration: Simply select the desired blade, insert the Flexi Master Trowel into the FlexiFit system, and start plastering. Blade changes are quick and effortless, ensuring maximum efficiency on the job.

Benefits :-

Efficiency and Comfort: The lightweight and easy-to-use design of the FlexiFit Trowel minimises fatigue, making plastering tasks less physically demanding.

Versatility: The interchangeable blade system offers customisation based on job requirements, enhancing overall productivity and adaptability.

Professional Results: The plastic blades' unique design ensures a professional matt finish every time, meeting the high standards of professional plasterers.

The FlexiFit range of interchangeable plastic and stainless-steel plastering trowel blades are proudly manufactured in the UK, ensuring top-quality craftsmanship and reliability. (Note: The FAIPFLEXMAS trowel is not manufactured in the UK.)

Title: Plumber's Soldering Mat 250 x 250mm
Body (HTML):
The Faithfull Plumber's Soldering Mat is a high temperature, Asbestos free protective heat mat for plumbing and soldering applications. It is ideal for DIY and light trade use, including soft soldering and most plumbing applications.

The heat mat withstands temperatures of up to 550°C and will provide protection to surfaces against burn marks and heat damage. For best results, the flame should not come into direct contact with the surface of the mat for prolonged periods. If the surface of the mat begins to glow it should be moved slightly so that the flame is redirected to a previously unheated area.

Always use the same side to face the flame to keep the reverse side clean against the surface being protected. If an area is to be exposed to heat for extended periods we recommended the use of two heat mats, layered for improved protection.

May be used with both Butane and Propane.

Specification

Max. Temperature: 550°C
Size: 250 x 250mm
Tags: Hand Tools, Building Tools, Gas Burners & Accessories, Toolbank

For best results always insure the white side of the pad is facing towards the heat source and avoid direct flame contact with the surface of the pad for prolonged periods. If the surface of the pad begins to glow it should be moved slightly so that the flame is redirected to a previously unheated area. The pad also features an easy wipe clean back and has reinforced edging.

Recommended for use with Butane, Propane and MAPP gas.

Body (HTML):
The Faithfull Multi-Tester is more than just a conventional voltage tester. The built-in battery powered sensor allows the multi-tester to perform a number of different functions without the need to dismantle a suspected faulty item or have any contact with live parts.

The multi-tester is fully insulated and is supplied complete with full operating instructions and will perform the following tests: continuity, bulbs, fuses, short circuits, cable tracking, mains sockets and microwave oven leakage.

Always read and the instruction supplied with the multi-tester.
Never use a multi-tester until you are fully conversant with its use and applications. Never work on live equipment, and if in any doubt, always contact a qualified electrician.

Title: Mains Tester 140 x 2.9mm 100-250 Volt
Body (HTML):
This Faithfull Mains Tester Screwdriver is fitted with a neon indicator in the clear plastic handle which illuminates when the point of the tester is touched on a live voltage source.

This mains tester is suitable for testing AC voltages from 125 to 250 volts against earth. The tip of the tester should be placed on the suspected live source, while finger touch contact is applied to the metal stud on the top of the handle. If the circuit or terminal contact point at the tip of the tester is live, the bulb will then light up as confirmation.

Note: ALWAYS test the mains tester on a known live source before use, to determine that its indicator bulb is functioning correctly prior to use.

WARNING: The earthing position of the user largely determines whether the tester bulb will illuminate or not. Failure to illuminate therefore does not provide 100% confirmation that no voltage is present.

Title: Light-Duty Mechanics Vice 100mm (4in)
Body (HTML):
The Faithfull Light-Duty Mechanics Vice for light to medium-duty applications is made from Spheroidal graphite (SG) cast iron, also known as SG iron, or Ductile Iron. During the manufacturing process the Graphite (carbon) element of the steel is shaped and aligned and adds the important “spherical” aspect to the name. This makes these vices both virtually unbreakable as well as much lighter than conventional grey cast iron, the material traditionally used for the construction of mechanics vices.

Manufactured and machined to close tolerances and is designed to offer smooth operation and reliability. An integral anvil assists with the hammering of materials. Supplied with a swivel base allowing the vice to be manoeuvred through 360 degrees, and locked in position as required. This base can be bolted onto a work surface for additional stability.

Plastic magnetic jaws can be ordered separately to allow the vice to be used for the clamping of soft, polished and round materials, without causing any damage. Code: FAIMAGVJ100.

Title: FSC Back Pull Saw 240mm
Body (HTML):
The Faithfull Back Pull Saw is ideal for woodworking and precision cutting. It's blade boasts a fine 21-teeth per inch design which is triple-ground, providing a smooth cut and a longer lifespan. The blade is constructed using SK5 steel and features a chemical nickel plating that enhances it's resistance to wear and corrosion. This saw incorporates a spine affixed to the blade for additional support and ease of use.

FSC-certified wood is used in the manufacture of this product. Wood products with FSC certification undergo a rigorous set of environmental, social, and economic requirements to be considered sustainable and responsibly sourced.

A pull saw is a type of handsaw that cuts when pulled toward the user, as opposed to a traditional saw that cuts when pushed away. Pull saws are widely used in woodworking and carpentry due to their efficiency and precision.

Pull saws have many benefits compared to saws which cut on the push action including:

• Precision: Pull saws are known for their precision and accuracy, making them ideal for intricate woodworking tasks that require fine cuts.

• Clean Cuts: The thin kerf and sharp teeth of pull saws result in clean cuts with minimal tear-out, leaving smoother edges on the workpiece.

• Efficiency: The pull stroke design of the saw allows for efficient cutting with less effort compared to traditional push saws.

• Control: The cutting action is achieved by pulling the saw towards you, which allows for greater control and accuracy compared to pushing.

The scribe is suitable for scoring ceramic wall and floor tiles prior to snapping to size and features a contoured handle that provides a firm grip and helps maintain the correct blade angle when scribing.

HOW TO USE:
Mark the tile to be cut and place it face up on a solid surface. Place a steel rule on the tile and line the ends up with your cut marks. Draw the tile scribe firmly along the rule to score the tile.
Thick tiles may need extra attention at the edges, score these independently if required.
Place the scored tile on to a flat surface with a piece of thin wire directly underneath the scored line and line up the wire with the score mark at the top and bottom of the tile. Once positioned correctly, apply pressure to both edges of the tile at the same time to snap the tile.

Title: Tile Levelling System
Body (HTML):
The Faithfull Tile Levelling System is a simple and easy way to install tiles. The levellers are made from polypropylene plastic and nickel-plated steel making them sturdy and perfect to use again and again.

The levelling system is easy to use, simply insert the T-pin between two tiles, rotate 90 degrees and tighten until the T-pin clamps onto the bottom of the tile. Then simply tighten further to adjust the level of the tiles.

To remove rotate the T-pin 90 degrees and pull the levellers out before the tile adhesive has fully dried. This system can be used for floor or wall tiles in both the home and for professional use. This set comes complete with 100 tile levellers and two polypropylene spanners to assist in the tightening process.

Title: Scouring Pad Holder + Fine Medium & Coarse Pads
Body (HTML):
This Faithfull handy kit, including Scouring Pad Holder and Fine Medium & Coarse Pads, contains all the essential components required to remove excess grout from tiled surfaces quickly and easy after grouting is completed.

Contents:
1 x Scouring Pad Holder.
1 x White (Fine) nylon pad.

The trowel (Scouring Pad Holder) is comfortable to use and fitted with a hook and loop fixing system, provides a large flat working surface for the rapid removal of grout and for final polishing of tiled surfaces.
Nylon pads may also be used for many cleaning applications around the home. The three grades of pads supplied provide added versatility for both tiling and cleaning tasks. For best results always use wet with water or the selected cleaning fluid.

White - Fine: A non-abrasive pad for high gloss polishing or light clean up jobs on stone or tiled surfaces. Excellent for the removal of grease and soap scum, when used with a mild cleaner or detergent. This pad can also be used for obtaining a high gloss polished finish. The open texture allows for a smooth even finish.

Brown - Medium: A general purpose abrasive pad for most cleaning and finishing requirements, excellent for cleaning or surface preparation. Removes fine grout haze and grout from tiled or stone surfaces and may be used with most solvents.

Black - Coarse: A heavy-duty abrasive pad for the initial cleaning of newly tiled areas and for the removal of excess grout. Use with heavy-duty cleaners for best results. Open mesh texture can minimise the loading of liquids efficiently and make it easy to wash out after use.

Title: Grout Scrubbing Brush Soft Grip Handle
Body (HTML):
The Faithfull heavy-duty narrow-headed Grout Scrubbing Brush is fitted with stiff nylon bristles and is suitable for use on all tiled surfaces. It is ideal for tackling stubborn grime, mildew and other forms of residue in hard-to-reach places and tight grout lines. A large soft-grip handle provides extra user comfort. It may be used in conjunction with most tile and grout cleaning detergent.

The handle unscrews to allow use of a longer handle such as FAIPATPOLE.

How to use:

Thoroughly clean the tiled area with a suitable cleaner and allow to dry. Spray the grout with a grout cleaner and allow 3 to 5 minutes to penetrate, but do not allow to dry. Use the special narrow brush head to track the groove allowing maximum bristle contact with the grout. Wipe clean with a damp cloth to ensure no dirt is washed back over into the grout grooves. For best results polish with a dry cloth.

Title: Upright Clamp
Body (HTML):
The Faithfull Upright Clamp is designed to be the helping hand when working alone. It will securely hold doors, sheet materials, studs for interior wood framing, and many other applications where the material requires support. The clamp gives the user the ability to easily mark-out, route-out, plane, and drill without the difficult job of keeping the material in place with a single hand.

Its strong grip will hold materials up to a width of 55mm (2 ¼in) making it ideal for working on FD30 and FD60 fire doors. Simply push the grip out of its holder, and securely lock onto the side of the object. This can be done with a hand, or foot, depending on the application it is used for.

The sturdy base can be used on table-tops and floors, with the added benefit of support screw holes that can secure the base in place when used with heavy objects. It can also be secured to an additional base (NOT supplied) for extra stability.

Specification:

Capacity: 15 – 55mm.

This strong durable vice offers many features including a four point bench mounting 360° swivel base and an ingenious rotating jaw head that allows the selection of either a standard parallel serrated jaw, or pipe jaws with an integral V-jaw assembly depending on the work in hand. The jaw head can be pivoted 180° either side of vertical and locked in position, meaning it is able to provide the perfect working angle for any application.

To avoid over-loading, the vice is fitted with a fused steel main handle.

These Forgefix Pozidriv, round head Corrugated Roofing Screws are Zinc plated for increased corrosion resistance. They come complete with a specially designed plastic fold over cap to suit installation of corrugated roofing. The plastic cap has a large surface area to improve weather resistance.

Screw size: 5.0 x 50mm (Pozi).

APPLICATION
Suitable for fixing corrugated sheeting to timber sub frames.

Zinc coatings prevent oxidation of the protected metal to create a longer lasting finish. It does this by forming a barrier and by acting as a sacrificial anode if this barrier is damaged. Zinc oxide is a fine white dust that (in contrast to iron oxide) does not trigger a breakdown of the substrate’s surface integrity as it is formed. The zinc oxide, if left intact, can act as a barrier to further oxidation, in a way similar to the protection afforded to aluminum and stainless steels by their oxide layers.

The Pozidriv screw is similar in appearance to the classic Phillips cross-head, but in fact is very different. The Pozidriv has four additional points of contact, and does not have the rounded corners that the Phillips screw drive has. The biggest advantage it offers is that, when used with the correct tooling in good condition, it does not cam out, allowing great torque to be applied. The Pozidriv screw can easily be distinguished by a line embossed in the screw head at 45° to the slots for the driver.

Round heads have a flat under head surface making the screw ideal for laying flat on sheet material of all types, reducing deformation.

Title: Dog Tooth Washer ZP 50 x 12mm Box 100
Body (HTML):
Forgefix Dog Tooth Washers are mainly used with Carriage Bolts, where timber to timber connections are required. The teeth bite in to the timber, offering a no movement fastening.
The washers are Zinc Plated for increased corrosion resistance.

APPLICATION
Used in many joints where restricted movement is required such as Roofing Joists, Newall posts on decking etc.
Can be used with many types of bolts and fasteners, in particular Carriage Bolts.

Zinc coatings prevent oxidation of the protected metal to create a longer lasting finish. It does this by forming a barrier and by acting as a sacrificial anode if this barrier is damaged. Zinc oxide is a fine white dust that (in contrast to iron oxide) does not trigger a breakdown of the substrate’s surface integrity as it is formed. The zinc oxide, if left intact, can act as a barrier to further oxidation, in a way similar to the protection afforded to aluminum and stainless steels by their oxide layers.

Title: Drywall Screw Wafer Head TFT ZP 4.2 x 13mm Bulk 1000
Body (HTML):
The Forgefix Phillips fine thread, wafer head Drywall Screws are zinc plated for increased durability. They come complete with a Phillips No.2 insert bit.
The screws have a self drilling hardened point designed for fitting dry linings to steel framework without drilling pilot holes.

Zinc coatings prevent oxidation of the protected metal to create a longer lasting finish. It does this by forming a barrier and by acting as a sacrificial anode if this barrier is damaged. Zinc oxide is a fine white dust that (in contrast to iron oxide) does not trigger a breakdown of the substrate’s surface integrity as it is formed. The zinc oxide, if left intact, can act as a barrier to further oxidation, in a way similar to the protection afforded to aluminum and stainless steels by their oxide layers. Zinc plating is the most common, economy, electroplated coating which is normally applied to ferrous components to give enhanced corrosion protection. The relatively low cost, protective nature and attractive appearance of zinc make it a popular coating for nuts, bolts, washers, screws, and similar interior components. In addition, zinc serves as an effective undercoat for paints when high corrosion performance is required.

The Phillips screw has four simple tapered slots. It is designed so that a Phillips tip screwdriver can turn a Phillips screw with increasing torque. When the torque gets to be too strong for the tip then the screwdriver tip winds itself out of the screw thus preventing over-tightening and or damage to the screw head.

The wafer head distributes the load under the screw head, offering a firm positive fixing in a similar way to that of a washer.

Fine thread screws have an extremely sharp point which not only pierces the plasterboard skin but will also allow the screw to drill through thin steel base structures.

Title: ForgeFast TORX® Compatible Flooring Tongue Groove Screw 3.5 x 45mm Box 200
Body (HTML):
The ForgeFast Elite Performance Tongue & Groove Flooring Screw is specifically designed to fix tongue and groove floorboards to timber flooring joists. The design ensures no damage is caused when fixed through the tongue. The reduced head with under head ribs is designed for self-countersinking allowing a very flush fit with the next board. The anti-split, fast start thread engages quickly to form a rapid pick-up at the start of insertion.

Reduced drive torque and no pre-drilling mean quick installations, whilst the fix remains firm with improved pull-out. Double cutting point reduces splitting and drive time, capable of penetrating 0.8mm steel.

A firmer fix with reduced drive torque and improved pull-out provided by a serrated cutting thread. Improved holding power from reinforced countersunk neck. Concealed countersinking from reduced ribbed head. TORX® compatible insert for higher transmission of power. CE approved for use in load-bearing timber construction. Molecular lubrication. Elementech 400 surface coating provides corrosion resistance. Salt spray tested to 400 hours. A Non-Cr, Cr3+, yellow/zinc plated surface is environmentally friendly. Lasts 6 times longer than standard zinc screw protective coating. Suitable for interior use.

Title: Multi-Purpose Pozi Screw CSK ST ZYP 3.0 x 10mm ForgePack 80
Body (HTML):
These Forgefix Multi-Purpose Pozi Compatible Screws with countersunk heads have a zinc yellow passivated finish for increased durability.

The screws are immensely popular and versatile, and used in all trades including joinery, electrical and plumbing. Also widely used in DIY applications.

APPLICATION

Suitable for use with many materials including PVCu, Timber, Chipboard, MDF, and other similar types.

The Zinc Yellow Passivation process of electroplating is similar to the 'Galvanised' and 'Zinc Plated' processes but with the addition of a yellow dye. It offers an aesthetically pleasing finish, whilst having excellent resistance to corrosion.

The Pozidriv screw is similar in appearance to the classic Phillips cross-head, but in fact is very different. The Pozidriv has four additional points of contact, and does not have the rounded corners that the Phillips screw drive has. The biggest advantage it offers is that, when used with the correct tooling in good condition, it does not cam out, allowing great torque to be applied. The Pozidriv screw can easily be distinguished by a line embossed in the screw head at 45° to the slots for the driver.

The countersunk head is designed to sink flush with substrates to leave a smooth surface finish. They have single threads, designed to offer higher pull out values and quicker insertion.

Supplied in a handy ForgePack.

Body (HTML):
The Forgefix Nyloc Hexagonal Nuts incorporates a nylon component to effectively lock the nut into position on the bolt.

The nylon component has a smaller inside diameter than the actual nut. This locks the nut in place by squeezing the nylon firmly around the bolt when tightened. Unlike a standard locking washer, the Nyloc nut prevents the nut from loosening under vibration as the nylon is tightly wedged into the bolt threads and provides resistance to turning when tightened.

The nuts are zinc-plated for increased resistance to corrosion. Their hexagonal shape is designed to be driven by a wrench (spanner) and provides excellent torque when done so.

APPLICATION:

Where a permanent fastening is required and loosening must be prevented by movement or vibration.

Can be used on most bolt products including HT Bolts, Carriage Bolts, Threaded Rod etc.

Zinc coatings prevent oxidation of the protected metal to create a longer lasting finish. It does this by forming a barrier and by acting as a sacrificial anode if this barrier is damaged. Zinc oxide is a fine white dust that (in contrast to iron oxide) does not trigger a breakdown of the substrate’s surface integrity as it is formed. The zinc oxide, if left intact, can act as a barrier to further oxidation, in a way similar to the protection afforded to aluminium and stainless steels by their oxide layers.

Title: Self-Tapping Screw Pozi Compatible Pan Head ZP 1in x 8 ForgePack 25
Body (HTML):
These Forgefix Pozidriv Self-Tapping Screws are zinc plated for increased resistance to corrosion. Their Pan Head, with a flat under head surface makes the screw ideal to lay flat on sheet material of all types, thus reducing deformation. The screws tap their own thread in a pre-drilled pilot hole, in sheet metal.

The screws are single threaded to resist pull-out.

APPLICATION
Ideal for use in many DIY, ironmongery, engineering, electrical and plumbing applications.

Zinc coatings prevent oxidation of the protected metal to create a longer lasting finish. It does this by forming a barrier and by acting as a sacrificial anode if this barrier is damaged. Zinc oxide is a fine white dust that (in contrast to iron oxide) does not trigger a breakdown of the substrate’s surface integrity as it is formed. The zinc oxide, if left intact, can act as a barrier to further oxidation, in a way similar to the protection afforded to aluminum and stainless steels by their oxide layers.

The Pozidriv screw is similar in appearance to the classic Phillips cross-head, but in fact is very different. The Pozidriv has four additional points of contact, and does not have the rounded corners that the Phillips screw drive has. The biggest advantage it offers is that, when used with the correct tooling in good condition, it does not cam out, allowing great torque to be applied. The Pozidriv screw can easily be distinguished by a line embossed in the screw head at 45° to the slots for the driver.

Body (HTML):
Loft Legs raise the loft floor by 175mm for energy efficient loft storage and help to avoid compression of the insulation, thus maintaining the U Values.
Easy to install, ultra strong and lightweight.

They are screwed directly to the ceiling joists. Loft boards (tongue and groove loft panels or 18mm chipboard sheets) are then screwed on top of the Loft Legs to create a raised platform above the level of insulation.

Squashing or compressing insulation reduces its effectiveness by over 50%. Home owners have traditionally had to make a choice with their lofts, full insulation OR usable storage space, the Loft Leg allows for both.

They are manufactured in the UK from recycled materials.

Title: Spectre™ Wood Screw Site Organiser 1200 Piece
Body (HTML):
Spectre™ by Forgefix incorporates a long list of advanced screw features, often only found in premium screws, into what we've named advanced multi-purpose wood screws.

They feature a countersunk, pozidrive compatible, recessed head. Fully threaded, up to 50mm, with a sawtooth thread, to prevent splitting and reamer to prevent jacking (50mm and above). They are also surface hardened with a quick start type 17 slash point.

The screws have a zinc yellow passivated finish for excellent resistance to corrosion. Zinc yellow passivation process of electroplating is similar to the 'galvanised' and 'zinc plated' processes, with the addition of a yellow dye. It offers an aesthetically pleasing finish.

CE approved for use in load-bearing timber construction.

Title: Threaded Rod Zinc Plated M20 x 1m Single
Body (HTML):
These Forgefix Threaded rods are bright Zinc Plated for increased corrosion resistance, and provide a cost effective fastening solution for many varied applications. They can be used with many other products including Drop In Anchors and Masonry Anchor Shields.

Conform to DIN 975 standards.

APPLICATION
Used widely in the soft furnishing trades where strong timber connection is required. Also extensively used in Playground and Climbing Wall manufacturing.
Ideal for use in chemical fixing applications where non standard sizes are required.

Zinc coatings prevent oxidation of the protected metal to create a longer lasting finish. It does this by forming a barrier and by acting as a sacrificial anode if this barrier is damaged. Zinc oxide is a fine white dust that (in contrast to iron oxide) does not trigger a breakdown of the substrate’s surface integrity as it is formed. The zinc oxide, if left intact, can act as a barrier to further oxidation, in a way similar to the protection afforded to aluminium and stainless steels by their oxide layers.

These Forgefix Spring Head Nails are a popular roofing nail for corrugated roofing. Their twisted shank assists in absorbing movement that may occur in the roofing construction. They are galvanised for increased resistance to corrosion.

APPLICATION:
Galvanised spring head nails are most commonly used for securing corrugated sheeting and other roofing materials.
Can be used with a rubber or plastic spat washer.

Galvanisation is process of applying a protective zinc coating to steel in order to prevent rusting. Zinc coatings prevent corrosion of the protected metal by forming a physical barrier, and by acting as a sacrificial anode even if this barrier is damaged.

Title: Worktop Clamp ZP 150mm Bag 10
Body (HTML):
These Forgefix Worktop Clamps eliminate the need for surface mounted worktop joining strips. The nut is tightened onto the bolt, pressing the caps against the walls of the 35mm diameter holes.
The clamps are Zinc plated for increased resistance to corrosion.

APPLICATION:
Worktop joints.

Zinc coatings prevent oxidation of the protected metal to create a longer lasting finish. It does this by forming a barrier and by acting as a sacrificial anode if this barrier is damaged. Zinc oxide is a fine white dust that (in contrast to iron oxide) does not trigger a breakdown of the substrate’s surface integrity as it is formed. The zinc oxide, if left intact, can act as a barrier to further oxidation, in a way similar to the protection afforded to aluminum and stainless steels by their oxide layers.

Title: RCD Adaptor (Circuit Breaker)
Body (HTML):
The Faithfull FPPRCD RCD Safety Adaptor Plug simply plugs into the mains, then you plug your electrical appliance into it. If there is a fault or a short in the tool you are using, the unit cuts the power very quickly, reducing the risk of electrocution

The Faithfull FPPRCD Safety RCD Adaptor continuously monitors the power supply to an electrical appliance and cuts off the power within 40 milliseconds if an earth current fault is detected. This is fast enough to prevent a fatal electric shock.

The Faithfull RCD Safety Adaptor Plug is an ideal way to protect yourself when using portable electrical tools, like lawnmowers, hedge trimmers and mains powered drills.
Electrical appliances can become dangerous if the wiring becomes loose, or their power cords become damaged or if they get wet.

Not only power tools and lawnmowers can cause electrocution is also possible if fingers, wet hair or other conductive bodies enter the appliance. In all these cases the Faithfull Safety RCD is a must.

Not for use on ponds as when disconnected the protection will be lost.

Can be used with any 240V appliance.
Particularly recommended for use with power tools.

Title: SS50 Hi-Security Combination Padlock 50mm Closed Shackle
Body (HTML):
The Squire SS50 50mm Hi-Security closed shackle combination padlock is purpose designed for extra-high security performance and extreme resistance against the threat of a sustained attack, with the added convenience of ‘no keys to lose’.

They operate using a fully recodable five-wheel dial with 10 digits - from zero to nine which offers over 100,000 code combinations. These padlocks are simple to recode and can be coded 'alike' so one code opens several locks, which makes them ideal for multi-users operating in high security or commercial environments.

Ideal for securing commercial buildings, gates, warehouses, lorries, perimeter gates, trailers and high security doors.

Title: Quattro 270 Adjustable Square 300mm
Body (HTML):
The Hultafors Quattro 270 Adjustable Square has a blade which can be rotated to 45°, 90° and 135°. It can also be rotated 270° allowing you to use the opposite side of the stock where there is no slit that, for example, thin sheet metal parts can slide into. In addition, there are markings for 22.5°, 67.5° and 75°/15°. If you rotate the blade 270° you get a rounded corner instead so you can work in uneven corners.

The stock is made of fully anodized aluminum with a 19mm thick handle. Its high strength stainless steel blade is 45mm wide and 1mm thick. This accommodates work with standard stud dimensions and a center line makes it easy to quickly mark out both sides of a stud. It also has scribing notches spaced 5mm apart, these can be used to draw or cut a line parallel along an edge.

Carefully selected materials and manufacturing techniques such as a CNC-milled stock and a blade cut with a precision laser provide high accuracy; angle tolerance ±0.06° (±1 mm/m). The square is also completely foldable, which makes it easy to store and carry in the pocket of your work trousers.

Made in Europe with full control over working conditions and sustainability.
Tags: Hand Tools, Measuring & Marking Tools, Squares, Toolbank

Title: Sliding Bevel
Body (HTML):
The Hultafors Sliding Bevel offers multiple smart features. The 20cm blade includes a durable, laser-etched millimetre scale and angle markings (0-90°) on both sides. The pointed end has a scribing notch, while the other end features a flattened edge, both designed for easy transfer of length measurements with a knife or pencil. The flat edge also includes its own length scale for depth measurements.

Our sliding bevel features a unique, extra-strong locking mechanism at the end of the stock. The ergonomically designed knob ensures a reliable lock when transferring the measured angle or length between workpieces.

The construction is robust yet compact, making it easy to fit in a tool pocket. The laser-cut blade is made of stainless steel, and the stock is made of certified anodized aluminium, which has a CO2 footprint that is only a quarter of the global average. Manufacturing takes place in Europe.

Title: Quattro Bevel Square
Body (HTML):
The Hultafors Quattro Bevel Square is an innovative adjustable square which also functions as a bevel square and an angle finder. The rotatable blade features fixed positions for 45°, 90°, 135° (180°, 225° and 270°). By rotating the blade more than 180° the opposite side of the stock where there is no slit can be used - for example, to provide a straight edge thin sheet metal cannot slide into. By shifting the lever, the Quattro can also be used as a bevel square to copy any angle between 0 and 270 degrees. A lever allows you to lock it at whatever angle you like. There is a scale on both the blade and handle to measure angles between 0 and 90 degrees. The square is also completely foldable, which makes it easy to store and carry in the pocket. 

The blade is 45mm wide to accommodate work with standard stud dimensions and has a centre line making it easy to quickly mark out both sides of a stud. It also has scribing notches, spaced 5mm apart, which can be used to draw or cut a line parallel along an edge. A robust joint and a 2 cm long blade of 1mm thick, high-strength stainless steel provides a very durable design withstanding tough working environments, and will last a long time.

Carefully selected materials and manufacturing techniques such as a CNC-milled stock and a blade cut with a precision laser provide high accuracy; angle tolerance ±0.06° (±1 mm/m).

Title: Flexible Indoor Camera
Body (HTML):
The Link2Home Flexible Indoor Camera makes sure that your home/workplace is safe and secure by enabling you to check in on your device anytime from anywhere. Secure connection, the camera utilises 128-bit SSL encryption. Ideal for checking in on pets or use as a baby monitor.

Install your camera anywhere thanks to its flexible neck. Use the neck to create a stand, wrap around surfaces such as a cot or use the mounting bracket included in the box. Plug in the optional temperature and humidity sensor to get readings direct on your video feed on your device.

With a built-in microphone and speaker, you can see who’s around and respond, listen and talk back via the Link2Home Pro app (Free). It also streams in full HD (1080p) to your chosen device. Additionally, you can get a 105° wide-angle view of the area, zoom in, and enhance, you will be able to see every detail. This is the same day or night thanks to Night Vision LED sensors which let you view the whole scene at night. The CMOS sensor also provides better image clarity compared to CCD Sensors.

The flex camera detects motion and sound, and instantly sends an activity alert to your device. If your flex camera detects something irregular, you can receive an activity alert on your smartphone with a snapshot of what happened. Title: Eyelet Puncher & Fixing Pliers

Use this eyelet puncher to punch and fix eyelets into thin materials such as fabric, leather, canvas, thin plastics and card. Ideal for: arts and crafts by professionals and hobbyists, leather work, shoes, clothes and dressmaking, costume jewellery making, stationery, schools and colleges.

Title: Safety RCD Adaptor
Body (HTML):
The Masterplug MSTARCDKGMP RCD Safety Adaptor Plug simply plugs into the mains, then you plug your electrical appliance into it. If there is a fault or a short in the tool you are using, the unit cuts the power very quickly, reducing the risk of electrocution.

The Masterplug Safety RCD Adapter continuously monitors the power supply to an electrical appliance and cuts off the power within 40 milliseconds if an earth current fault is detected. This is fast enough to prevent a fatal electric shock. The Masterplug RCD Safety Adaptor Plug is an ideal way to protect yourself when using portable electrical tools, like lawnmowers, hedge trimmers and mains powered drills.
Electrical appliances can become dangerous if the wiring becomes loose, or their power cords become damaged or if they get wet. Not only power tools and lawnmowers can cause electrocution is also possible if fingers, wet hair or other conductive bodies enter the appliance. In all these cases the Masterplug Safety RCD is a must.

Not suitable for pond pumps and other pond equipment as when these are removed the installation is unprotected.

Safety RCD (Circuit Breaker)
Can be used with any 240v appliance.
Particularly recommended for use with power tools.

Body (HTML):

Title: IM350+ 1st Fix Gas Framing Nailer
Body (HTML):
Reliable in all weather conditions, the Paslode IM350+ 1st Fix Gas Framing Nailer is strong and durable, to guarantee tool performance and reliability. It is ideal for carpenters, roofers and general builders working on new build and renovation projects.

This highly-rated cordless nailer has a redesigned nail lip and by-pass follower allowing for smoother nail loading, making the operation quicker and hassle free. The fan also runs longer after rapid nail firing helping to cool the tool quicker, which prevents overheating.

The lightest nail gun on the market and improved ergonomics help enhance the user experience. Its rubberised grip handle makes the tool comfortable to hold, and the tool itself is better balanced, which means you can work in comfort and fatigue free.

The nailer's lithium battery is fast charging and delivers up to 9,000 shots per charge, equal to over 4 nail fuel packs. It is compatible with the standard Paslode Lithium battery and benefits from Paslode's renowned quality and durability - it will withstand wear and tear, guaranteeing a tool both strong and reliable.

This IM350+ is now the seventh generation, benefitting from 40 years of customer insight and innovation.

Supplied with: 1 x Li-ion Battery 2.1Ah, 1 x Charger, 1 x Pair of Safety Glasses (EN166-F Rated), 1 x Allen Key and 1 x Case.

Title: 360Xi Framing Nailer 7.4V 1 x 2.1Ah Li-ion
Body (HTML):
The Paslode 360Xi Framing Nailer delivers an unbeatable power to weight ratio, enabling it to drive long nails into the hardest substrates. Title: IM45 GN Lithium Multipurpose Coil Nailer 1 x 2.1Ah Li-ion
Body (HTML):
The Paslode IM45 GN Lithium Multipurpose Coil Nailer has the ability to fire a wide range of nails that suit different applications including: metal roofing, shingles, cladding and fencing. Compact and lightweight design that is faster and safer than existing methods, with no need for compressors and hoses.

No debris nail collation, used plastic coil is ejected out of the tool in one piece allowing for easy tear off and disposal. Unlike wire welded collation type, the plastic strip prevents small collation particles from damaging the installation in the long term. Delivers a perfect flush finish every time. Title: PPNXi Positive Placement Nailer 7.4V 1 x 2.1Ah Li-ion
Body (HTML):

Title: PR Spray 400ml
Body (HTML):
ROCOL PR Spray is designed to give fast, efficient clean release in critical moulding applications. It penetrates and spreads to all parts of the most intricate mould to give full, clean release, with improved gloss finish.

PR Spray gives a fine, controlled spray with complete coverage for maximum economy. Use on all types of blow, injection, flow and compression moulding, particularly on complex tooling. Helps overcome difficulties encountered during setting and start up.

It has a gloss finish, the nature of the gloss finish is not suitable for painting or printing on the surface, please see MOULD RELEASE Spray for an alternative dry film product which is suitable to printing and painting on.

Specification

Temperature Range: up to +200°C
Tags: Consumables, Lubricants, Production Lubricants, Toolbank

Title: MOULD RELEASE Spray 400ml
Body (HTML):
ROCOL MOULD RELEASE Spray is a high performance PTFE based release agent. Designed to give fast, efficient and clean release with faithful reproduction of the mould profile however complex the mould or minute the detail. Suitable for use on all plastic and rubber mould tools including injection, compression and blow mouldings. Enabling high speed production.

MOULD RELEASE Spray offers excellent adhesion, is non-staining, will not transfer to product and can be safely used without fear of blemish or any adverse effect on subsequent finishing operations.

Provides a dry matt finish, which is ideal for over painting or printing on, for a gloss finish please see PR Spray.

The Record Power RSBG8 Bench Grinder has a long-established reputation for robustness and reliability, making it the perfect choice for the home workshop. This new and upgraded machine has an industrial-inspired design with a heavy-duty motor and offers improved power, stability and performance.

It features fully adjustable tool rests with solid locking mechanisms to give optimum support. Title: WG200 200mm (8in) Whetstone Grinder 160W 240V
Body (HTML):
The Record Power WG200 Whetstone Grinder offers performance and versatility in a compact and easy to use machine. Some machines rely purely on the weight of the motor to apply drive to the wheel. This can be insufficient for more demanding tasks. The WG200 has adjustable torque so you can easily apply the correct pressure for the job in hand.

As the stone wears, its diameter reduces and so in effect the speed of the wheel's rotation is increased. On most machines you cannot do anything about this, but with the WG200 you can lower the speed to compensate. In addition, when you want to remove material more quickly you can increase the speed of the stone.

For added safety, its left hand nut thread ensures the grinding wheel is held securely with no danger of unwinding.

Title: WG250 250mm (10in) Whetstone Grinder 160W 240V
Body (HTML):
The Record Power WG250 Whetstone Grinder with a range of high-quality jigs and accessories is essential for many woodworkers and is also an extremely useful tool for general household tasks, such as the sharpening of knives, gardening tools and many other items.

The WG250 is the result of research carried out with a number of renowned turners and woodworkers who looked at the other machines on the market and advised what they thought was needed to improve on what was available.

There are a number of features that make this machine stand out from the competition - some small but significant details as well as some major points of difference to most of its rivals. It has a Friable stone is specially designed so that as the abrasive wears, heat increases reducing adhesion so that the worn abrasive minerals come away to reveal fresh and effective new crystals.

With variable speeds from 90-150/Min. The stone wears the diameter reduces. On most machines you cannot do anything about this, but with Record Power you can adjust the speed to compensate. The left-hand nut thread ensures the grinding wheel is held securely with no danger of unwinding.

The WG250 has adjustable torque so you can easily apply the correct pressure for the job in hand or as the drive wheel wears. In addition to the polycarbonate water tray, the WG250 features a drip guard to help protect the top of the machine and re-direct drips into the main tray. An integral storage tray offers a convenient storage space for the most used accessories such as the stone grader and angle finder.

Included in this package is the WG250/K Diamond Truing Tool, an essential accessory to ensure the outer diameter remains concentric and the sharpening surface perfectly flat.

Title: Garden Furniture Stripper 750ml
Body (HTML):
The Ronseal Garden Furniture Stripper is great at stripping away any existing stains, oils and paints that are on your garden furniture. It's perfect for when your furniture isn't looking it's best or you fancy a bit of a change.

Simply brush on and scrub off, works in just 30 minutes and only requires one coat (stubborn spots may need 2 coats).

Before you start, make sure it's a warm day (above 10°C) and that it's not going to rain. If you use it when it's colder it'll take longer to work. If it's too cold, it may not work at all. Give the furniture a quick wipe to get rid of any dirt. Protect any plants with a sheet to stop them getting splashed.

USING YOUR GARDEN FURNITURE STRIPPER

Put on some gloves and give the tin a good shake. Get loads of stripper on your brush. The more you put on, the better it'll work. It doesn't blister or fizz when it's working. But trust us, it is.

Leave it for 30 minutes. Don't let it dry out, if it does it won't work. Then check to see if it's ready by scraping it with something sharp, like a paint scraper. If it's not, put a bit more on and leave it for another 10 minutes. You'll then need to give it a good scrub with a stiff hand brush. As it's coming off, pour on a bit of water and keep scrubbing. This'll help get it all off.

If your furniture has slats, you may need to use a paint scraper or something similar to get where your brush can't reach. Finally, hose down until the water runs clear and leave it to dry. Let your furniture dry for a day or two, and then you'll be ready to put on a new finish.

Cleaning up, scrape off as much stripper off your tools as you can. Then wash them out in warm, soapy water. Don't pour any left over stripper down the drain or into watercourses. Your local authority may have special ways to get rid of unused products.

Coverage : 5.3m² Per litre.

Title: Hardwood Garden Furniture Restorer 1 litre
Body (HTML):
The Ronseal Hardwood Garden Furniture Restorer helps to get your worn grey wood back to its natural colour. It is the best prep you can do before putting on a stain or oil, you will get a much better finish. Its low odour gel formula is safe to use around your plants and pets, so you do not have to worry about splashes. Before you start, get your furniture ready. Use a stiff brush to get rid of any dirt. Firstly, give the tin a good stir, do a test patch to make sure you are going to be happy with the result before applying overall. Generously coat the restorer onto the furniture and then scrub it in with a stiff bristle brush.

Leave it to work for 15 minutes, don’t let it dry out, as it won’t work properly, if it does, you will need to put another coat on. You will then need to give it another scrub. Finally, give it a good hose down, you should be able to get the job done with one coat. However, very grey wood may need doing again. If you get any restorer on yourself, wash it off with warm, soapy water. To keep your furniture looking its best, leave it to dry for a day or two. Then protect it with one of our stains or oils.

When cleaning up make sure to scrape as much restorer off your tools as you can. Then wash them out in warm, soapy water. Don’t pour any leftover restorer down the drain or into watercourses. Your local authority may have special ways to get rid of unused products.

Size: one litre.
Coverage: 8m² per litre.
Coat Time: 15 Minutes
Dry Time: one to two days
Water Based

Suitable for use on all treated patio and block paving including flag stones, granite, cast, limestone and sandstone.

Prepare the surface as directed on the Patio & Block Paving Seal pack

For Satin Finishes: Apply two coats of Patio & Block Paving Seal prior to applying Anti Slip
For Wet Look Finishes: Apply one coat of Patio & Block Paving Seal prior to applying Anti Slip

Make sure the seal is fully dry before continuing.

Title: Total Wood Preserver Clear 5 litre
Body (HTML):
Ronseal Total Wood Preserver is a general-purpose preserver that has been specially formulated to kill woodworm and prevent rot and decay. It is an ideal pre-treatment for interior wood and suitable for overpainting. Perfect to use on rough or smooth timber.

This clear wood preserver does not waterproof and is made for preserving indoor wood.

Before You Start: Ensure all surfaces are clean, dry and free from surface coatings such as paint, varnish or stain etc. Where timbers are suffering from decay, before applying Ronseal Total Wood Preserver, remove all decayed wood and replace it with sound, treated timber. Cut out and burn all decayed wood at least 45cm beyond the area of damage.

Application: Shake well before use. Ronseal Total Wood Preserver can be applied by brush, spray or dipping. If applying by spray use a coarse spray and avoid misting. Note that Ronseal Total Wood Preserver is not compatible with Ronseal Sprayers. Where possible end grains should be treated by dipping to ensure complete penetration. Apply a minimum of 2 coats, covering all faces, sides and joints, paying particular attention to the end grain. The second coat should be applied after 24 hours. When the second coat is dry, repairs and gluing can be carried out. Avoid contact with bitumen, bitumen felt or mastics and plastics.

Title: Wood Bleach Set (A & B Solution 500ml)
Body (HTML):
The Rustins Wood Bleach Set removes weather stains and discolourations. Makes bare wood white or lighter in colour. Use to bleach natural timber to a lighter shade so it can then be stained to another wood shade, using Rustin’s Wood Dyes.

Preparation:

Will only work on bare wood. All varnish, lacquer or polish must be removed before applying the solutions. Old finishes are best removed with Rustin’s Strypit Paint and Varnish Stripper.

Remove as much of the old finish as possible with a scraper, then damp the surface again with Strypit and rub with the grain with NO 1 or 2 steel wool. Wipe surface with clean rag and allow to dry.

Application:

Apply solution A to clean, dry wood with a brush and leave for 10-20 minutes before applying solution B.

Some woods will darken when solution A is applied. The actual bleaching takes place after application of solution B.

Coats: one coat of solution A followed by a coat of solution B.

Drying Time:

After application of solution B leave for a minimum of 2 hours. If the product dries out it can form crystals which can be very difficult to remove so ensure sufficient solution is applied to prevent drying out.

Re-coating Time: If the wood is very dark or badly stained, repeat application of both solutions after 2 hours.

Body (HTML):
Rustins Quick Dry White Wood Dye is a low odour water based dye to transform the colour of wood. It is touch dry in 30 minutes and can be over-coated after 2 hours with any of the Rustins range of finishes.

It is suitable for all types of wood, hardboard, MDF and cork. The colour is fade resistant and will enhance the natural grain of wood.

Can be diluted with water but do not exceed a 30% dilution. Before use check that the colour is what is required. Do not mix with white spirit or solvent.

Title: Fall Arrest Pro Harness 5 Point
Body (HTML):
The Scan Fall Arrest Pro Harness 5 Point is commonly used within the construction industry, by scaffolding and steel erectors plus any at height workman. It is made from 100% polyester and features: a dorsal attachment D-ring, 2 attachment webbing loops on the chest and thigh strap and 2 side D-rings on the waist support belt, shoulder strap and thigh strap.

It has a flexible, lightweight design that offers very little restriction to movement. Fitted with additional comfort features: a comfort pad within the waist support belt and an adjustable chest, waist and thigh strap.

Supplied with a thick micron poly bag.

Strength >23kN, manufactured and tested to EN 361, EN 358 and EN 1497
Tags: Workwear & Safety, Personal Protection Equipment, Fall Arrest Equipment & Lanyards, Toolbank

Title: Fall Arrest Harness 2-Point Anchorage
Body (HTML):
The Scan Fall Arrest Harness is a commonly used full-body harness and comes with a metal D-Ring attachment and leg straps. It is suitable for most work-at-height applications in the construction industry (scaffolders, steel erectors etc.) and has fully adjustable leg, shoulder and chest straps. The rear dorsal plate slides upwards to keep the user upright after a fall and it has a robust metal front attachment point with polyester webbing and front and rear attachment.

Maximum user weight: 100kg. Conforms to EN 361:2002 and EN 362:2002 standards and is supplied in a storage bag.

Over 7,000 falls from height in the workplace were reported to the UK Health and Safety Executive during 2006-07, 24 of these were fatal.

Falls from height are the most common cause of fatal injury and the second most common cause of major injuries, accounting for around 15% of all such injuries in the workplace.

Title: 4 Dial Combination Key Safe
Body (HTML):
The Scan Keysafe is the ideal safe storage of house, car and padlock keys. Its 4-digit combination allows for 10,000 different codes for added convenience and improved security. A plastic shutter door protects the combination dials from the elements ensuring no dirt or grit gets into the mechanism.

Can be wall mounted using the supplied fixings (check substrate for correct fixings) It can be mounted either inside or outside. Suitable for the home, office, workshop, or anywhere where keys are required in an emergency.

Width: 90mm.
Height: 119mm.
Depth: 49mm.
Security Rating: 6.
Tags: Security, Home Security, Key Safes & Cash Boxes, Toolbank

Title: 4 Wheel Combination Keysafe with Removable Shackle
Body (HTML):
The Scan Keysafe with removable shackle is the ideal safe storage of house, car and padlock keys. Its 4-digit combination allows for 10,000 different codes for added convenience and improved security. An ABS plastic shutter door protects the combination dials from the elements ensuring no dirt or grit gets into the mechanism.

The removable shackle is the ideal solution for temporary portable storage as it can be shackled to an anchor point and then removed when not required and can then be stored in the keysafe body. It can be mounted either inside and outside and is suitable for the home, office, workshop, or anywhere where keys are required in an emergency.

Supplied with 2 rubber bungs to prevent water ingress when the shackle is not being used. Can be wall mounted using the supplied fixings (check substrate for correct fixings).

Title: FatMax® Pistol Grip Ratchet 12 Bits
Body (HTML):

Title: No.220 Block Plane
Body (HTML):
This professional general-purpose adjustable Block Plane has a fine grey iron body and is adjustable for depth of cut and alignment.

A block plane is designed to cut end grain and is typically small enough to be used with one hand with the cutting blade (also known as an iron) bedded at a lower angle with the bevel up compared against other planes. It is frequently used for paring end grain, possible because its blade had been set at a shallow bed angle. This allows the blade to slice through end grain more efficiently; furthermore, for this to work, the plane is frequently held at an angle sometimes as much as 45° to the direction of travel, so that the cutting edge slices the wood fibers as they pass from one end of the cutting edge to the other.

A block plane has many other uses in woodworking, ideal for cleaning up components by removing thin shavings of wood in to make a component fit within fine tolerances. Chamfering (angling square edges) and removing glue lines are some of the other uses woodworkers find for the block plane.

Cutter Width: 40mm (1.5/8in).
Length: 180mm (7in).

Title: Pocket Pro Level (Loose)
Body (HTML):
The Stabila Pocket Pro Magnetic Level is a professional quality spirit level which fits in the pocket, or can be attached to a belt with the clip supplied.
This little compact level has strong magnets holding the level in place on horizontal or vertical surfaces.
This Stabila level is made from precisely ground aluminium, and can measure pipe surfaces with its V-groove base.
Stabila Pocket Pro Magnetic is ideal for craftsman having pride in their work. The level has a robust case with aluminium core for added strength with two milled measuring surfaces on the side, and base.
These professional levels allow the user to take measurements on flat and round surfaces, as both the base and lateral measuring surfaces have an extra strong rare earth magnet which is up to 5 times stronger than normal ferrite magnets. This will leave your hands free for adjusting and aligning metal objects.

Title: REC 300 Digital Receiver to suit LAR200 & 250 and LAR300 & 350
Body (HTML):
The Stabila REC 300 Receiver has two displays: one each on the front and back for fast measuring and taking readings in any position. Digital display of the reference deviation in mm, in, in (fractions) and ft. Allowing you to read the deviation from the reference height directly in figures, for faster and more precise correction of strut positions and concrete levels.

A series of symbols indicate your distance from the reference height and whether you are too high or low. Two sensitivity levels simplify setting-up over longer or shorter distances. If you also switch on the acoustic signals, you can select two volume levels. Its loud signal can be heard even with a loud background noise.

Compatible with: LAR200, LAR250, LAR300 and LAR350 lasers.

Title: REC 500 RG Rotation and Line Receiver
Body (HTML):
The Stabila REC 500 RG Rotation and Line Receiver quickly and accurately determines the beam position of rotation lasers or pulse-modulated line lasers with red or green laser diodes, even over large distances outdoors or in bright indoor lighting.

It has a two-sided digital display for fast work. Visual indication with arrow symbols on the display shows the position of the receiver relative to the reference plane of the laser. It also has optional multi-colour LED guidance (red, orange, green) and acoustic guidance (beeping tones for which the volume can be set). With four sensitivity levels for application-oriented work: ± 0.3mm (very fine), ± 1.0mm, ± 2.0mm, ± 5.0mm (very coarse).

The casing is waterproof and dustproof in accordance with protection class IP67; providing protection against rain during outdoor use and against dust during drywall construction. It has a variety of mounting options, a holder for attaching to levelling rods and an integrated magnet system.

Specification:

Battery Life: 50 hours
Protection Class: IP67

Title: Maintenance Kit
Body (HTML):
The Telesteps Maintenance Kit keeps your ladder clean and safe. Your telesteps product should be stored clean, particularly the telescopic tubes and rungs. Dirt, filings, paint spots, glue etc. must be cleaned after each use, and before the ladder is closed. If your ladder is soaking wet, fully extend the ladder, wipe off and keep it extended until the ladder is completely dry.

The ladder is not safe if any of the parts are damaged or worn out. Don’t use the ladder if it needs to be repaired. Replace damaged parts or/and contact your authorized service workshop for assistance. Any repair work must always be carried out by an authorized service workshop.

Treat your Telesteps Products with care and it will retain its unique properties. Follow strictly recommendations and steps, in order to always have a safe product ready for your daily challenges.

The Telesteps Maintenance Kit includes:

1 x High Quality Microfiber Towel.

1 x Cleaning Sponge to remove dirt and other stains on the products.

Maintenance Instructions & Yearly Inspection Plan.

Body (HTML):
Thor Classic Copper & Hide Hammer with a Malleable Iron THOR branded head fitted with one copper and one hide face.

Combines force, finesse and traditional craftsmanship. Use the copper face for harder strikes with maximum impact, then switch to the hide face for softer, controlled blows which won’t damage delicate surfaces. Vital for any environment where surface protection and safety are essential. Recommended for car maintenance, bicycle repair, aerospace, rail, toolmaking and metalworking. The cast iron head provides long-lasting durability for heavy-duty use.

99.99% pure electrolytic copper face: The faces are cut from pure electrolytic extruded pure copper bars. Copper's natural non-sparking properties make the face crucial for work environments where striking steel on steel contact poses a safety risk, making it perfect for high-impact tasks without surface damage.

Compressed, sustainable water buffalo hide face: The hide absorbs recoil and dampens sound, offering a firm strike that won’t mark finished surfaces. This makes it ideal for delicate work, restoration and use in noise-sensitive environments.

Fitted with a durable anti-vibration, wooden handle. Crafted from high-quality hardwood, it minimises recoil for enhanced comfort and control.

Thor’s founding hammer from 1923 remains a trusted tool by professionals for over a century.

Its powerful motor delivers consistently high power, torque and speed, and features soft-start to prevent kick-back. With 7-level variable speed control, it gives the user total control across a range of cutters, materials and applications.

Automatic power shut-off prevents the router from accidental start-up if the trigger lock-on switch is engaged and the power supply is lost and restored or interrupted. The Precision Centring System features a unique guide bush centring pin and adaptor plate that ensures perfect concentricity between cutter and guide bush for pinpoint accuracy with routing jigs.

Fitted with ergonomic inclined handles that support a natural wrist position, reduce strain and increase control when routing with arms outstretched. Trend Base Configuration includes a standardised fixing pattern of holes that allow routers to be attached to a range of compatible tables, jigs and accessories. An integrated router rest provides users with a safe way of changing cutters whilst preventing debris from entering motor vents.

Top-Mount Cyclone Extraction with enhanced dust adaptor efficiently clears debris to give users 360° visibility and prevent extraction hoses from ‘snagging’. Automatic LED work lights allow users to accurately position the cutter prior to engaging the material and making costly errors in low-light situations.
